_about: Corrections to QuestieDB for WoW Forever, from what players see in game. gen_route.py applies them before planning. drop: the quest isn't in the game (or not worth routing). preQuestGroup / preQuestSingle: quests that must be handed in first. Each entry says who saw what, and when.

98096.note: Sisters In Duty: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade only offers Eyes of the Sentinels (98067) until it's done. Seen in game by Gary, 14 Nov 2026.

3763.note: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm (innkeeper breadcrumb): Innkeeper Saelienne offers no quest in game. Seen 14 Nov 2026; Forever seems to have removed the innkeeper breadcrumbs.
